description: A PERSONAL MESSAGE FROM VICTOR… I’ve got great news! This week marks a significant breakthrough for our campaign. Momentum is moving forward quickly, and the small group of critics trying to slow us down are now exposing themselves. We didn’t lift a finger; they’re struggling to defend their own poor decisions. Integrity and leadership always win. At the same time, interest is at an all-time high. Daily donations are up, and volunteers are more energized than ever. We’re entering the next phase
title: Team Victor Weekly Update - January 25, 2026
